title: Gambit catalog of games: manifest
description: Index of a release of the Gambit catalog of games. Paths are relative to the games/ directory. Consumers must ignore properties they do not recognise.

schema_version.description: Version of this schema; bumped on a breaking change to the manifest. A manifest of another version is described by that version's schema.

catalog_version.description: Version of the catalog this manifest describes (semantic versioning).

work.description: A work in the catalog's bibliography: the fields shared by a source and an origin.

citation.description: Short form: Author (Year), Author and Author (Year), or Author et al. (Year).

authors.description: Full names of the authors, or of the editors if the work has none.

title.description: Title of the work, as plain text.

venue.description: Journal or, for a work in a volume, the volume's title; absent for a book.

kind.description: BibTeX entry type, in lower case (article, book, inproceedings, ...).

source.description: The work the game is taken from.

origin.description: Earlier work the game itself comes from, where the source took it from elsewhere.

note.description: Remark on how the game differs from the game in the origin.

slug.description: Canonical name of the game; also its directory under games/.

title.description: Title of the game: its citation, locator and name, as <citation>, <locator>: <name>.

name.description: Conventional name of the game, when it has one.

description.description: Plain-text description, with citations resolved to (Author Year).

format.description: Format of the game file: efg (extensive game) or nfg (strategic game).

drawings.description: Committed drawings (.ef) of the game, the primary drawing first.

n_strategies.description: Total number of pure strategies (reduced, for extensive games) over all players.
